title: Can I BEAT King of the Bridge? (Ascension Ending)
summary: King of the Bridge (pixel-art troll chess game) for the 'Ascension' ending: promote all of your pawns. Rule book references rules 2, 4, 11 (crown transfer), 25 (pieces can't leave the board unless they 'work out of town'), 28 (not stated). Troll dialogue mentions 'Rock, Paper, Dragons'.
rules: Base King of the Bridge rules (see WEYUcaJTBso): rule book, Troll cheats, Space to accuse; correct accusation lets you cheat once; false accusation = lose turn + troll revenge.

RULE 02: you can only move your own coloured pieces. RULE 04: piece movement rule ('...move like this...'). Rule 11: crown transfers when the troll king dies. Rule 25: pieces can't leave the board unless they 'work out of town' (bishops).
Ascension objective: promote every one of your 8 pawns ('ascensions').
win_condition: Promote all your pawns to unlock the Ascension Ending.
